mapper.select: select d.dept_id companyDeptId,d.dept_name companyName,t.tax_rate taxRate,coalesce(t.version,0) version,t.update_by updateBy,t.update_time updateTime from sys_dept d left join biz_company_profit_tax t on t.company_dept_id=d.dept_id where d.parent_id=100 and d.del_flag='0' and d.status='0' and order by d.order_num,d.dept_id
select dept_id from sys_dept where dept_id=#{companyDeptId} and parent_id=100 and del_flag='0' and status='0' for update
select tax_rate taxRate,version from biz_company_profit_tax where company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_company_profit_tax(company_dept_id,tax_rate,update_by) values(#{companyDeptId},#{taxRate},#{userName}) on duplicate key update tax_rate=values(tax_rate),version=version+1,update_by=values(update_by),update_time=now()

select r.project_id projectId,p.project_name projectName,p.project_no projectNo,p.company_dept_id companyDeptId, company.dept_name companyName,coalesce(selected_department.dept_id,owner_department.dept_id) departmentId, case when coalesce(selected_department.dept_id,owner_department.dept_id) is null then '未设置部门' when coalesce(selected_department.dept_id,owner_department.dept_id)=p.company_dept_id then '公司直属' else coalesce(selected_department.dept_name,owner_department.dept_name) end departmentName, p.base_currency currency, date_format(r.biz_date,'%Y-%m-%d') bizDate,r.result_id resultId,r.profit_amount profitAmount,r.is_adjustment isAdjustment, coalesce(s.tax_rate,t.tax_rate,0) taxRate,case when s.project_id is not null then '1' else '0' end taxFrozen, case when s.project_id is not null then s.configured when t.company_dept_id is not null then '1' else '0' end taxConfigured from ( select project_id,biz_date,result_id,profit_amount,0 is_adjustment from biz_project_daily_result where is_current='1' union all select project_id,posting_date,null,sum(profit_delta),1 from biz_closed_project_adjustment where status='APPROVED' group by project_id,posting_date ) r join biz_project p on p.project_id=r.project_id left join sys_dept company on company.dept_id=p.company_dept_id and company.del_flag='0' left join sys_user project_owner on project_owner.user_id=coalesce(p.main_owner_user_id,p.initiator_user_id) and project_owner.del_flag='0' left join sys_dept owner_department on owner_department.dept_id=project_owner.dept_id and owner_department.del_flag='0' left join sys_dept selected_department on selected_department.dept_id=p.department_id and selected_department.del_flag='0' left join biz_company_profit_tax t on t.company_dept_id=p.company_dept_id left join biz_project_profit_tax_snapshot s on s.project_id=p.project_id where p.del_flag='0' and
and (p.project_id=#{projectId} or p.company_dept_id=(select target.company_dept_id from biz_project target where target.project_id=#{projectId} and target.del_flag='0')) and p.company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} and r.biz_date<=#{dateTo} order by r.project_id,r.biz_date,r.is_adjustment,r.result_id

select p.project_id projectId,p.company_dept_id companyDeptId,coalesce(t.tax_rate,0) taxRate, case when t.company_dept_id is null then '0' else '1' end configured, coalesce((select sum(r.profit_amount) from biz_project_daily_result r where r.project_id=p.project_id and r.is_current='1'),0) pretaxProfit from biz_project p left join biz_company_profit_tax t on t.company_dept_id=p.company_dept_id where p.project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_project_profit_tax_snapshot(project_id,company_dept_id,tax_rate,configured,pretax_profit,tax_amount,aftertax_profit,create_by) values(#{projectId},#{companyDeptId},#{taxRate},#{configured},#{pretaxProfit},#{taxAmount},#{afterTaxProfit},#{userName}) on duplicate key update project_id=values(project_id)
